description: This file defines the TabStopRenderer class, responsible for rendering a TabStop object into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering framework.

classes.name: TabStopRenderer
classes.description: A class that extends RendererBase to render a TabStop object as RTF output.

methods.name: TabStopRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a DocumentObject (specifically a TabStop) and an RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Method that performs the rendering of the TabStop into RTF, translating properties such as Alignment, Leader, and Position.
